SPECIAL BRANCH REGISTRY.
File No. J.0.428.

SUBJECT

List of Chinese Warships, which have
joined the Republican Army; Translation
from "Min Kuo Tao".
pages.zh:
特别处档案室。
档案号 J.0.428。

主题

加入共和军的中国军舰名单；译自《民国报》。

pages.en:
428
4/7/16

The following are the names & description of 9 Chinese
warships attached to the 1st Squadron which
have joined the Republican Army, together
with the names of their Commanders.
From Min Kun fa.

▲海軍第一艦隊表 海軍部人員編製局印 本表由該局派員調查填註並經海軍總長核定呈請大總統批令照行計開
（民國元年三月廿五日奉大總統批令照行）
